decision: The exact public WildRelight revision passes the frozen metadata-only feasibility gates for one separately preregistered bounded source-observation leaf. It is public and CC BY 4.0, exposes a complete revision-pinned inventory with 30 scene groups, 762 paired photo EXRs, 762 paired environment-map EXRs, 120 capture metadata files and explicit capture roles. This pass does not authorize downloading the complete 200.9 GB corpus, does not claim that the DNG names in metadata are published DNG bodies, and does not consume candidate 3.
excluded_infrastructure_and_parser_histo: Before the final execution lock, a 64 KiB per-page ceiling and an HTTPS disconnect prevented report publication; the transport-only correction increased the already-bounded ceiling to 128 KiB and added bounded retry handling. The first complete diagnostic used Hugging Face's wrong absent lfs.sha256 field and counted two auxiliary rail/time-1 environment maps as paired roles. The additive parser correction uses the official lfs.oid SHA-256 field, classifies the two auxiliary files separately, and refreshed only the manifest identity before final execution. During the final dual run, one reverse process encountered three TLS handshake EOFs and produced no report; the independently restarted reverse process succeeded without source, method, role, gate or threshold changes.
claim_ceiling: Private rights-clear paired-HDR source feasibility only. No EXR or DNG payload was requested. No relighting or HDR quality, radiometric calibration, independent generalization, shared operator, A1/A4/A5, public package/schema/capability/product admission or candidate 3. Passing opens only a separately preregistered, hash-selected, bounded one-scene source observation.
